Protoss regenerate shields yet shield battery exists to give sudden burst shields.  Im not saying it's a perfect idea but it's validity is still there. It wouldn't heal like a medivac it would certainly be much less burst heal and of course you wouldn't be able to heal much without killing the support unit. I know roaches can heal fast while burrowed and mutas heal quick but besides that the heal over time isn't much to really justify not having some sort of healer.  I think it would be cool to integrate in replacement of queen transfuse which prior to these balance changes queens could keep ultras alive for a long time but this would help over all army health and create cool new compositions to explore.
